in_sanskrit.name: मीना
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has a beautiful forehead, sweet, and having a round or plump body. This name is derived from the Sanskrit words मीन (mīna, meaning 'moon') and ना (nā, meaning 'lotus'). In Hindu mythology, Meena is the name of the goddess of the moon and is associated with the lunar calendar.
